'''Voidcaller''' is a [[Knives|knife]]. It is dropped by [[The Void]].

Its primary attack is a stab costing 6 [[Stamina]]. Its secondary attack deals three times the damage and costs 18 Stamina. It deals 6x damage against unalerted enemies.

Its recipe is disabled in the current game build, so it cannot be crafted or upgraded at a [[Galdr Table]] or the [[Forge of Potential]].
